description: Somos estudiantes del colegio María de Fátima, queremos ganar experiencia y desafiar nuestros conocimientos.
summary:
Our Project: Astronauts Pixel 
We  created  Astronauts  Pixel,  an  interactive  educational  game  developed  using  HTML,  CSS, and  JavaScript,  featuring  a  pixel- art  style.  Players  can  explore  real  NASA  missions,  build rockets, choose equipment, manage budgets, and face challenges during spaceflight. 
Because  understanding  space  exploration  should  be  fun  and  accessible.  Our  game  allows children  and  teenagers  to  learn  more  about  space,  discover  science,  and  develop  curiosity that could influence their future interests and career choices.
Our  game  responds  to  the  challenge  by  turning  complex  space  mission  planning  into  an interactive  experience  where  every  decision  can  make  a  difference.  With  the  help  of  AI,  we were  able  to  develop  a  simulation  inspired  by  the  tasks  and  decisions  involved  in  NASA space missions. Of  course,  we  recognize  that  our  prototype  is  not  perfect  and  still  has  room  for  improvement. If  we  receive  additional  support  and  resources,  we  aim  to  improve  the  accuracy  of  our physics  simulations,  create  more  realistic  rocket- building  mechanics,  expand  our  mission catalog, and integrate real- time NASA data. With  further  support,  we  could  continue  developing  our  project  and  make  space  exploration even more realistic, accessible, and educational.
details: Astronauts Pixel is a game designed to teach young people about the key factors and resources required to launch a rocket into space, including costs, fuel types, and scientific instruments. The game runs smoothly on any web browser and features an intuitive interface that guides players step by step. Players can jump right in by creating a simple username, and they also have the option to download their game progress as an XML file to reload and continue later. To provide an authentic experience and valuable insights, the game integrates and displays real-world data sourced from official platforms. Because of this, we view Astronauts Pixel not just as a game, but as a practical learning tool. In the future, we hope it will serve as an accessible educational platform for anyone interested in space, as well as a teaching aid for educators around the world to share this knowledge with as many students as possible. Our development process began with the team sketching out wireframes for each screen of the game and selecting which datasets from NASA and other official sources to incorporate. In the final stage, we crafted a series of detailed prompts for Claude to generate the game using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, based directly on our sketches and chosen data.
